article_context: Cover image for an article about preparing for pregnancy: it introduces a caring couple and the shared anticipation of a future baby, before the practical health recommendations begin.
image_reading: Close crop of two adults standing side by side, their joined hands holding a pair of small red baby sneakers.
The sneakers hang centrally against a softly blurred outdoor background; a ring and the shoes make the future-parenthood theme explicit.
